scope: The public street-facing reception building and entrance canopy of Kerobokan Prison in Bali, with the low visible roof forms immediately behind.

originalReview.notes: Davidelit’s original CC0 photograph shows the cream fascias, broad low canopy, recessed shaded public windows, brick-red base trim, maroon hipped roofs and raised Lapas Denpasar name.

quallaSearch.notes: Compared the original available in Qualla first. Its native file and first revision confirm Davidelit’s direct CC0 release. Used the visible public street frontage.
